tldr: Mercury through the 8th house brings focus to shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement.
body: Mercury transiting the 8th house activates shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports shared money and deep trust: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or control, avoidance, or crisis attachment.
advice: Name the details in the 8th house deliberately. Work with shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
